question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a pink ball, Bob has a orange ball, Claire has a teal ball, Dave has a blue ball, Eve has a yellow ball, Fred has a grey ball, and Gertrude has a black ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Gertrude and Dave swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap balls. Then, Fred and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Eve and Bob swap balls. Then, Eve and Bob swap balls. Then, Dave and Fred swap balls. Finally, Fred and Eve swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) pink ball
(B) orange ball
(C) teal ball
(D) blue ball
(E) yellow ball
(F) grey ball
(G) black ball
solution:
Ball colors in order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial: pink | orange | teal | blue | yellow | grey | black
1. Gertrude swaps with Dave: pink | orange | teal | black | yellow | grey | blue
2. Gertrude swaps with Fred: pink | orange | teal | black | yellow | blue | grey
3. Fred swaps with Gertrude: pink | orange | teal | black | yellow | grey | blue
4. Eve swaps with Bob: pink | yellow | teal | black | orange | grey | blue
5. Eve swaps with Bob: pink | orange | teal | black | yellow | grey | blue
6. Dave swaps with Fred: pink | orange | teal | grey | yellow | black | blue
7. Fred swaps with Eve: pink | orange | teal | grey | black | yellow | blue
Bob has the orange ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
